---
name: Ticket (maintainers)
about: A work item against a user story, written before the code (step 3 of the development process in CLAUDE.md).
title: "T-<story>-<letter> — <what changes>"
labels: []
---

- **Source:** US-x.y AC-n (link the issue the work came from, if any)
- **Defect / Why:** what is wrong or missing, with a measured example
- **Change:** files and functions that change
- **Class search (SCAR-017):** every place of the same kind, with a decision per place
- **Guard search (SCAR-023):** tests that forbid a call this ticket adds or removes
- **Tests:** test files, red before the code
- **Not measured here (SCAR-024):** what only a manual check can show
- **Status:**
